That the Assistant Commissioner (Land), Companygonj, Sylhet in violation of the above mentioned memo dated 17.10.1985 initiated Miscellaneous Case No.147 of 2004-2005 under section 92(2) of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 for taking over 1.54 acres of land out of that 20 acres of land under khas khatian No.1 of the Government and in that miscellaneous case by the impugned order dated 22.03.2005 the Assistant Commissioner (Land), Companygonj, Sylhet treated the aforesaid 1.54 acres of land as khas land of the Government with a direction to the concerned officials to take over possession of the same. 

 6. The respondent No.1 opposed that rule. The material case of the respondent No.1 was that though the predecessors of the writ petitioners took lease of the land in question from the government for a period of 25 years the writ petitioners did not take any step for renewal of the said lease after expiry of that 25 years and as such the lease deed lost its validity after that period; that the government cancelled that decision in respect of non-renewal of long term lease and as such there was no illegality in starting Miscellaneous Case No. 147 of 2004-2005 under section 92(2) of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 and the impugned order passed therein. It was also alleged from the side of the contesting respondent that the writ petition was not maintainable since the writ petitioners did not challenge the impugned order by filing a suit in civil court as per section 29(4) of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act. The High Court Division, after hearing the learned Counsel of both the sides and examining and considering the relevant annexure made the rule absolute declaring the impugned miscellaneous case and the impugned order passed therein illegal and directed the respondents to renew the long term lease of the land in question in favour of the writ petitioners and to receive rents from the writ petitioners regularly.
